soldier: Large form: head gourd-shaped, its posterior part very broad, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle, the nasus upturned, the elevation of the base of the nasus inconspicuous, the frons slightly concave, the vertex slightly swollen, the apical tooth of the mandible inconspicuous; antennae with 13 segments, the fourth shortest, the third slightly longer than the second; anterior part of the pronotum erect and shorter than the posterior part, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle, the posterior margin nearly straight; abdomen olive-shaped. Small form: colour and chaetotaxy as in the large form, head pear-shaped, the posterior margin concave in the middle, the nasus slightly upturned, antennae with 13 segments, the pronotum nearly flat, abdomen olive-shaped.
worker: Small worker: head pale yellowish brown, abdomen and legs yellow. Head round and somewhat square, widest behind the antennae, the T-shaped suture visible; antennae with 14 segments, the fourth shortest.
